target_customer: Developers and mid-size operating businesses in manufacturing, retail, distribution and logistics
problem: Data and decision logic are scattered across systems; Clidey offers an open source database explorer and a data platform that models entities and runs decisions on live data.
business_model: Open source core (WhoDB) with commercial ERP and AI assistants; pricing not stated
product_category: Developer tools and open source data platform

founders.name: Hemang Kandwal
founders.background_notes: YC bio cites 20 plus proofs of concept with BlackRock, J.P. Morgan, Craneware and ARM

founders.name: Anguel Hristozov
founders.background_notes: Employers come from a Docucod launch post cited in the YC page, which says the founders worked at places like Palantir, J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley; attribution per person not certain

competitors.name: Adminer
competitors.what: Lightweight web database admin tool that WhoDB positioned itself as a modern successor to

technical_complexity.rationale: Go and React explorer across Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse and more, plus a decision and ERP platform with 47 modules claimed; wide scope for a team of five.

defensibility.rationale: Open source Apache 2.0 licensed tool in a field with DBeaver, DataGrip and others; the ERP layer has no visible moat yet.

market_need_then: Database GUIs have steady developer demand; WhoDB launch threads on Reddit in June 2024 drew discussion, but no usage figures were found.

branding.community_and_virality: WhoDB has a public GitHub repo and Reddit and Dev Community launch posts in mid 2024.

brand_strength.rationale: Open source repo gives developer visibility, but the company name Clidey and product name WhoDB differ and drift with the ERP pivot.

pivots.from: WhoDB open source database explorer (launched mid 2024) and documentation tool Dory
pivots.to: Organization modeling decision platform and 47 module ERP

outcome_analysis: Clidey grew out of the open source WhoDB database explorer, launched in mid 2024, and entered YC in Spring 2025 pitching a decision platform now sold as an ERP. There is no public funding or revenue data, and the product scope has widened considerably. Outcome unknown.
notes: VCBacked lists 500K pre-seed from Y Combinator in June 2025 and a London location with a documentation description, which may be Docucod; unverified. The branding name_origin field was set from an inference; treat as unknown. Education for both founders not found. One aggregator lists WhoDB as discontinued and another as active; GitHub not opened.
